research.title: Uncertainty Estimation Under Changing Feature Missingness
bullets: Formulated how changes in feature missingness affect predictive uncertainty and led development of a missingness-conditioned probabilistic regression approach.
Evaluated interval calibration against imputation baselines using controlled missingness mechanisms, separating uncertainty from unobserved features and observation noise.

research.title: Regularized Class Proportion Estimation Under Label Shift
bullets: Investigated instability in label shift correction and led development of a constrained class proportion estimator with confusion matrix regularization.
Compared regularization choices under simulated class prevalence changes, examining estimation sensitivity to calibration errors and limited labeled validation data.

research.title: Robust Weighted Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated questions about estimated density ratios in conformal prediction and led development of a stabilized weighting procedure for shifted regression data.
Designed simulation studies and diagnostic analyses comparing coverage, interval width, and weight concentration across controlled covariate shifts and density ratio estimators.

publications.title: Stabilized Density Ratio Weighting for Conformal Regression Under Covariate Shift
Diagnosing Coverage Sensitivity to Estimated Weights in Conformal Regression

work.title: Data Import Validation and Error Handling
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for tabular data imports, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate records within existing application workflows.
Added regression tests for import failures and revised error messages to distinguish malformed input from processing failures during maintenance.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sparse Regression Estimators
bullets: Implemented coordinate descent for lasso regression and compared its solutions with reference estimators using synthetic datasets with correlated predictors.
Evaluated ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression through nested cross-validation, examining prediction error and coefficient stability across resampled training sets.

projects.title: Approximate Inference for Bayesian Logistic Regression
bullets: Implemented Laplace approximation and mean-field variational inference for Bayesian logistic regression, using shared priors and preprocessing for comparative evaluation.
Compared posterior uncertainty and predictive calibration across approximation methods, inspecting sensitivity to prior scale and class separation in simulated datasets.

projects.title: Calibration Methods for Probabilistic Classification
bullets: Implemented temperature scaling and isotonic calibration for probabilistic classifiers, keeping calibration data separate from model fitting and final evaluation.
Compared reliability diagrams, proper scoring rules, and calibration sensitivity to validation sample size across linear classifiers and neural networks.

projects.title: Kernel Two-Sample Testing for Distribution Shift
bullets: Implemented maximum mean discrepancy tests with permutation calibration and compared kernel choices on synthetic location, scale, and mixture shifts.
Evaluated rejection behavior under matched and shifted distributions, examining bandwidth selection and computation costs against a classifier-based two-sample baseline.
